_doc: Documented exceptions of the process-safety guard (D-C0-48). Each needs an owner and a reason; a stale entry fails the guard. The guard scans STRINGS, so a test TITLE that merely names a forbidden command is a finding unless it is listed here.

allow.reason: the title of C5's own scanner test (it ASSERTS the absence of these commands in C5 tooling); the file never runs them. Rephrase the title and delete this entry when C5 next touches the file.
